title: Trusty Ramhound gets +1 Might even when it is the only unit at its location
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/trusty-ramhound.ts) has no explicit abilities, so enrich-cards.ts:30 runs parseAbilities on rulesText. Verified by running the parser: output is {condition:{type:"custom",text:"While you have another unit here"}, effect:{type:"modify-might",amount:1,target:"self"}} — produced by static-parser.ts:658-665 (whileConditionMightMatch fallback to type "custom" when parseConditionFromText fails). In the engine, static-abilities.ts:749 calls evaluateCondition; the switch at static-abilities.ts:112 has no "custom" case, so it hits the default at static-abilities.ts:330-333 which returns true. The +1 Might is therefore applied unconditionally, including when Ramhound is alone.
observed: Fresh game, played Ramhound to an empty base: server state meta.staticMightBonus=1 and the board might badge (.card-might) shows 3 with no other unit at base. Same 3 after adding a second unit. Cause: parser emits condition {type:'custom', text:'While you have another unit here'} and static-abilities.ts default branch treats unknown conditions as true, so the bonus is unconditional.

history.note: Parser now emits exists-here (excludeSelf/location:here) for 'While you have another unit here'; static evaluateCondition implements exists-here so the +1 Might is conditional

resolution.note: Parser now emits exists-here (excludeSelf/location:here) for 'While you have another unit here'; static evaluateCondition implements exists-here so the +1 Might is conditional
